nate: Quick note - during rwdx-13b-int4 onboarding I hit a small but reproducible post-restore token-repeat when priming > 10k tokens. Putting minimal repro and logs here.

nate: Repro (local):
```
RWD_MODEL=rwdx-13b-int4 ./serve --quant=int4 --kv-restore=true --max-context=65536
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"[~11k priming tokens]\",\"max_new_tokens\":256,\"seed\":9}'
```

nate: Symptoms: generation matches float baseline up to restore point, then a short phrase repeats 2-3x and beam scores drop. Warm server OK.

emily: Do you have a hexdump of the snapshot tail?

nate: small excerpt: `... 4e 2a 9b 0f 0f 0f 0f 0f` - repeating 0x0f tail nibbles.

emily: Sounds like writer padded with 0x0f and loader isn't masking nibble tail. That would only affect int4.

raj: Quick fix: ensure snapshot header carries nibble_count and loader masks last nibble. Also add CRC in header so we detect truncation/padding earlier.

ci-bot: Queued: int4-kv-tail-check (CI-13001).

emily: I'll add a tiny regression that writes an int4 snapshot, restores it, and does token-level diff against float for contexts [4k, 12k, 24k]. Fail on KL>threshold or repeat-rate spike.

nate: Temporary mitigation: set KV_RESTORE=false for int4 in staging pools.

raj: I pushed a small compat PR to parsing/loader that treats v1 headers as word_count -> nibble_count conversion and sets format v2 when nibble_count present. Also added CRC32. PR: https://git.internal/rwd/p/pkr/+/4901

ci-bot: CI-13001 finished: failure in shard 7 tail check. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/13001

emily: Good catch. Once PR merges we'll run fleet-scan for snapshots with suspicious padding and refuse to load ones with CRC mismatch.

nate: Filing RW-ML-2150 to track follow-ups. If anyone else sees cold-start repeats on int4, drop logs here.
